newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues tender to buy 10,000/T June fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: India issues tender to buy 10,000/T June fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 10,000 tonnes of 3.5-percent sulphur fuel oil for June delivery, traders said on Thursday.
IOC seeks to buy the 180-cst grade cargo for delivery June 28-30 on a Mangalore cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender, IOC's first purchase tender for June delivery, will close on June 12 and is valid for one day.
"The amount of this tender is pretty small," said one trader. "I think IOC may issue more import tenders for demand in the summer season."
India last awarded its tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of May fuel oil at $3 per tonne above Middle East spot quotes on a free-on-board Gulf basis.
